samples.title: FIR_01 (Hinglish)
samples.text: Police Station Special Staff ke tahat FIR No.201/2026 u/s 318(4)/61(2) BNS ke antargat mukadma darj kiya gaya. Gupte suchna ke aadhar par police team ne suspicious vehicle DL-5C-AB-5012 ko intercept karke suspect Vikas Sharma urf Bicky @ Viku @ Kallu s/o Shri Harish Sharma r/o Block-A, Lane-1 ko hirasat mein liya. Banking ledger scrutiny se pata chala ki accused Vikas Sharma ne sum Rs. 20,144.99/- beneficiary account 95217729622 mein credit karwaya. Ukt khata 95217729622 mule handler Rajendra Singh dwara secretly manage hota tha. CDR analysis se pata chala ki phone 6834738299 ne doosre mobile 6112805982 par multiple voice calls kiye. Search memo ke dauran suspect ke bag se cash rashi INR 15,000.00 alag se recover hui jo hawala proceeds ka hissa batayi gayi. Accused Vikas Sharma ke pas se operational calling connection 6834738299 zabt shuda paya gaya. Zabt shuda SIM 6834738299 handset IMEI 837631165667016 ke slot mein operational tha. Duty Officer Arvind Swaminathan ne recovery proceedings ko endorse karke formal statment record karwaya. Mauke par co-accused Bikas Sharma urf Biku s/o Shri Girish Sharma bhi maujood paya gaya jise apprehended kiya gaya. Zabt shuda material ko sealed pullanda mein safe custody hetu police malkhana mein jamah kiya gaya.

samples.title: FIR_52 (English)
samples.text: Police intelligence wing registered the preliminary investigation under FIR No.302/2026 u/s 318(4)/61(2) BNS. Acting on specific intelligence, police intercepted vehicle DL-7C-AB-4249 and apprehended accused Vikas Sharma alias Bicky @ Viku @ Kallu s/o Shri Harish Sharma r/o Block-D, Lane-4. Co-conspirator Bikas Sharma alias Biku s/o Shri Girish Sharma was simultaneously taken into custody. Upon personal search, accused Vikas Sharma was found in possession of mobile handset 68347 38299. The seized connection 68347 38299 was paired with equipment hardware IMEI 837631165667016. Investigating Officer Amit Tomar attested the contemporaneous seizure inventory at the scene. Account statement scrutiny demonstrated that origin account 6066011655865115 remitted funds amounting to 20,995.42 to destination account 199656789564. The recipient account 199656789564 is operational under the personal stewardship of Rajendra Singh. During physical search, an additional cash sum of Rs. 15,000/- was recovered from the vehicle glove box. Cellular CDR scrutiny revealed that handset 68347 38299 exchanged repeated telephone traffic with 6604817549. The recovered contraband and related articles were duly inventoried and lodged into safe custody.

samples.title: FIR_A (Live Demo)
samples.text:
POLICE STATION CYBER CRIME, NORTH DISTRICT, DELHI
FIRST INFORMATION REPORT
FIR No.: 142/2026
Date & Time: 2026-03-02 11:30:00
U/S: 318(4)/61(2) BNS

Mukadma ba-tahreer SI Anil Deshmukh darj register kiya gaya. Gupte suchna ke aadhar par police team ne Sector 18 ke pass ek suspicious vehicle DL-01-AB-1234 ko intercept karke suspect Rohit Verma urf Rocky s/o Shri Mohan Verma r/o Lane 4, Shastri Nagar ko hirasat mein liya. Accused Rohit Verma ke personal talashi ke dauran uske kabze se mobile phone 9823011223 (bearing IMEI 864201948201948) baramad hua. CDR scrutiny se pata chala ki handset 9823011223 ne master calling number 9811022334 par frequent voice calls kiye. Accused Rohit Verma ne confess kiya ki usne hawala proceeds ki rashi Rs. 2,25,000.00/- transfer kiya into bank account 40192837465. Jaanch se yeh clear ho gaya ki ukt khata 40192837465 syndicate handler Amitabh Sen @ Amit s/o Shri Pradip Sen dwara secretly control kiya jata tha. Baramad shuda phone tatha cash rashi ko police custody mein liya gaya.
